company: Cipher Digital Inc. (f/k/a Cipher Mining Inc.)

claims.claim_text: In October/November 2025, Cipher (via Cipher Black Pearl LLC) entered a 15-year lease with Amazon Web Services, Inc. to deliver approximately 300 gross MW of turnkey data center capacity at the Black Pearl Facility in Wink, Texas, with phased delivery commencing in 2026, rent commencement targeted for Q4 2026 (Phase I) and Q1 2027 (Phase II).
claims.subject: Cipher Black Pearl LLC
claims.object_value: Amazon Web Services, 300 MW, 15-year term, Wink TX
claims.source_quote: In October 2025, through our wholly-owned subsidiary Cipher Black Pearl LLC, we entered into a 15-year lease agreement with Amazon Web Services, Inc. ... to deliver approximately 300 gross MW of turnkey data center capacity at the site (Black Pearl).

claims.claim_text: In Q3 2025 (lease dated Sept 24, 2025), Cipher (via Cipher Barber Lake LLC) entered long-term HPC leases with Fluidstack USA II Inc. for the 300 MW Barber Lake Facility in Colorado City, TX; Google LLC has agreed to backstop Fluidstack's obligations via a Lease Recognition Agreement and Google received warrants (the 'Google Warrants') with exercise period commencing at lease commencement and expiring Sept 24, 2030. Phase I delivery targeted Sept 30, 2026; Phase II Jan 31, 2027.
claims.subject: Cipher Barber Lake LLC
claims.object_value: Fluidstack USA II Inc. (300 MW); Google backstop + warrants
claims.source_quote: Fluidstack/Google Data Center Lease ... we entered into long-term HPC leases with Fluidstack USA II Inc. ... supported by a lease recognition agreement, pursuant to which Google LLC has agreed to backstop certain obligations of Fluidstack under our HPC leases with Fluidstack.

claims.claim_text: Cipher's data center portfolio consists of 4.2 GW of capacity across 10 sites. As of FY2025, it operates ~207 MW (Odessa BTC mining), is developing 600 MW of HPC across two sites (Barber Lake 300 MW + Black Pearl 300 MW) for hyperscaler tenants, and maintains a pipeline of ~3.4 GW across seven Texas sites + one Ohio site.
claims.subject: Cipher Digital
claims.object_value: 4.2 GW total; 207 MW operating; 600 MW HPC under development; 3.4 GW pipeline
claims.source_quote: Our data center portfolio consists of 4.2 gigawatts of capacity across 10 sites ... currently developing 600 MW of HPC data center facilities across two sites for hyperscaler tenants, and we currently operate approximately 207 MW of power at one bitcoin mining data center in Texas. We also maintain a pipeline of approximately 3.4 GW across seven sites in Texas and one additional site in Ohio.

claims.claim_text: Black Pearl Facility has received approvals for 300 MW of interconnection from ERCOT-affiliated utility infrastructure; Barber Lake Facility has received approvals for 300 MW of interconnection without restrictions on load profile and entered into agreements necessary to participate in ERCOT market.
claims.subject: Cipher
claims.object_value: Black Pearl 300 MW + Barber Lake 300 MW = 600 MW ERCOT-side interconnection approved
claims.source_quote: Cipher Barber Lake has received approvals for 300 MW of interconnection without any restrictions on the load profile ... Black Pearl Facility has received approvals for 300 MW of interconnection and has entered into agreements necessary to participate in the ERCOT market.

claims.claim_text: In 2025, Cipher and subsidiaries raised approximately $3.2 billion of gross proceeds via convertible and senior secured notes ($172.5M 1.75% 2030 convertibles in May 2025, $1.3B 0% 2031 convertibles in Sep 2025, $1.733B 7.125% 2030 Senior Secured Notes by Cipher Compute), plus $195.5M net from ATM at $5.88 avg. Subsequent to year-end (early 2026), Black Pearl Compute LLC issued an additional $2.0B of 6.125% senior secured notes due 2031. Total consolidated indebtedness at 12/31/25 was $3.206B; FY2025 net loss $822.2M; accumulated deficit $1.004B; cash $628.3M; cash used in ops $207.9M.
claims.subject: Cipher Digital
claims.object_value: $3.2B 2025 gross financings + $2.0B 2026 Black Pearl secured notes; massive convertible overhang; $822M net loss
claims.source_quote: In 2025, we raised approximately $3.2 billion of gross proceeds through convertible notes offerings and senior secured notes offerings ... Subsequent to December 31, 2025, Black Pearl Compute LLC ... incurred $2.0 billion of 6.125% senior secured notes due 2031.

claims.claim_text: Cipher claims $713.5M of supplier commitments (mostly Barber Lake construction, fully funded with restricted cash), with construction commitments to complete Barber Lake in 2026. Black Pearl Facility's prior BTC mining operations ceased in early 2026 (after a 150 MW September 2025 ramp), pending HPC tenant lease commencement mid-2026 — thus near-zero HPC hosting revenue currently recognized despite the high-profile AWS / Fluidstack-Google headline contracts.
claims.subject: Cipher Digital
claims.object_value: $713.5M construction commitments; HPC hosting revenue recognized in FY2025 is effectively zero; BTC mining ceased at Black Pearl in early 2026 with no replacement revenue until Q4 2026 lease commencement
claims.source_quote: we have commitments of approximately $713.5 million as of December 31, 2025. The majority of commitments relate to construction at the Barber Lake Facility ... bitcoin mining operations at the Black Pearl Facility ceased in early 2026, and we will not earn revenue at this site until the site's lease to an HPC tenant commences ... expected commencement date of mid-2026.
